purpose: Extend the prior frozen factorial memory-encoder diagnostic to labeled-empty target frames, using real source memories from the two previously inspected recent/spread sequence-23 trajectories. This assesses local false-alarm behavior, not full-video efficacy.
scope: Engineering source frames 7,11 and targets 8,12 of seq3. Previously inspected inset-excluded sequence-23 labeled-empty target frames 10,18,34,38,42, with respective source frames 9,17,33,37,41. These were selected post-hoc after checking prior labels and masks: most follow divergent source masks, and frame 38 was a false alarm for the recent trajectory. Labels are for selection and scoring only, not model inputs.
capture: In one read-only pass reuse the existing encoder-argument and attention/decoder observers. Run two independent engineering captures for each policy, compare every mask/trace with its verified original trajectory and compare the captured tensors to the existing independently verified separate observers. Verify the actual bfloat16 feature storage reconstructs the next-read newest block. Then capture both full seq23 trajectories without changing inference, requiring all 56 masks and traces to match the previously verified runs; independently reconstruct source encoder outputs and target-read newest blocks.
intervention: Reuse the pinned author _encode_new_memory model, same learned parameters and its exact bfloat16 storage path. For each recipient and selected target, hold its current query, full condition, older history, insurance, positional encodings, pointer suffix and native decoder/presence behavior fixed. Re-encode the source frame with all eight combinations of recipient or other trajectory image features, predicted mask logits and native object-score logits; insert only the newest spatial feature block. Confirm recipient-only is exact no-op and donor-only exactly reproduces the donor newest block. Combinations can be off-manifold; no target label, extra redetection, new inference threshold, gate or altered object-presence rule is used.
verification: Two independent engineering factorial replays and an independent exact encoder/attention/decoder reconstruction are required before any selected video read is intervened on. Repeat the seq23 factorial replay independently, verify every saved mask and native target object logit in a third process, freeze outputs and independently recalculate labeled-empty false alarms, predicted pixel counts and changed pixels.
limits: These are five previously inspected, correlated, selected empty frames; empty annotations may be incomplete. Mixed image/mask/object inputs can be mutually inconsistent. Results do not identify additive causes or evaluate an online selection method, a threshold change, full-video false-alarm rate, patient independence, or generalization.
